newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-ROKISHKIS CHEESE MOST ACTIVE STOCK LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-ROKISHKIS CHEESE MOST ACTIVE STOCK LAST WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that the most active stock last week was official list company Rokishkis Cheese, with a turnover of 6.285 million litas registered in block trades.
Rokishkis was followed by Hermis Bank, which saw 2.454 million litas worth of its shares change hands in block trades last week.

Alytaus Textile was the most active on the central market with a turnover of 320,000 litas followed by Siauliu Bank turning over 241,000 litas and Lithuanian Shipping company which saw 219,000 litas worth of its shares change hands.

The gainers of the week included A group firms Sastatas with 20.89 percent rise to 6.54 litas, Dirbtinis Pluoshtas advancing 19.51 percent to 0.49 litas and Linas increasing by 13.33 percent to 0.34 litas last week.

Kaunas Milk eased the most in the A group last week by 18.55 percent to 2.24 litas followed by Kuro Aparatura which fell by 15.38 percent to 5.5 litas and Vilniaus Pergale which was down to 16.05 litas by 9.93 percent.
Hermis Bank was the biggest gainer on the official list of the Vilnius bourse last week and rose by 7.14 percent to 195 litas.
It was followed by Medienos Plaushas which advanced to 11.8 litas by 6.31 percent last week.
Rokishkis Cheese was the only official list company which eased slightly last week by 1.18 percent to 42 litas.
